about.heading: About

It has all of the cards for free with an automatic Swiss Tournament system and ranking. The DU discord hosts weekly tournaments with prizes and even casual players with beginner knowledge of Yu-Gi-Oh can find something to enjoy!

method.title: How it’s counted
method.body: Each game counts once per deck, so a Bo3 adds up to six deck-games. Win rates leave out mirrors and unfinished games; a draw counts as a game, not a win. Meta share keeps everything. Decks with fewer than {minSamples} deck-games are left out of the lists, so shares don’t add up to 100%. Unknown decks count in the totals, not as a row. ± is the 95% Wilson interval. Tier: a deck's share against the most played deck's (T1 ≥ 60%, T2 ≥ 30%, T3 ≥ 15%, T4 ≥ 5%; none under 0.5% of the meta).

note.mostPlayed: Share of all deck-games, mirrors included.
note.highestWinRate: Ordered by the low end of the 95% interval: a small sample can’t top it alone.
note.rising: Meta share of the last days (up to 7) against the same span before.
note.sleeper: Decks under 5% of the meta, by the low end of the 95% interval.
note.consistent: The worst low end of the interval across blocks of up to 7 days with 100+ games.
